svg.aria-label: How it works: Scan. Students put a finger on the K40 as they come in. Nothing else to carry or sign.; Read. Herewise reads the scans over a direct Ethernet cable. No router, no internet.; Sheet. Each class fills in the lecturer's own attendance sheet, ready as PDF or Excel.; Decide. The examination eligibility list follows from the sheet, with every correction noted.
